title: Offline Text Diff Desk — Private Side-by-Side Comparison
customer_problem: People reviewing two local versions of a plain-text document need an easy private way to see edits without copying sensitive contents into an online diff website.
audience: Windows users comparing local plain-text notes, configuration files, logs, or CSV text who want a clear bilingual desktop view and a reproducible offline diff.
differentiation: Two-file read-only comparison with an explicit whitespace option, bounded UTF-8 inputs, unified diff export, and recoverable session metadata; no upload, telemetry, or source-file edits.
scope: Open two user-selected UTF-8 local text files with strict size, line-count, binary and symlink validation.
Compare line changes using a bounded unified diff and optional whitespace normalization, with a visible empty/equal state.
Offer side-by-side read-only text panels and an accessible result panel in a 1024x768 bilingual desktop layout.
Save and reopen validated JSON session paths and options atomically, keeping a previous-version backup for recovery.
Export a local diff report without modifying the original documents and with explicit overwrite confirmation.
Run headless functional tests for reading, invalid files, diff semantics, session recovery and export.
research_note: Distinct public GitHub issues are weak untrusted problem signals only. Original implementation. Cohort 4/5. No copied code/assets or external APIs.
